critical_dependencies: Explicit transition semantics that make both policies credible and keep external disturbances identical while independently generating policy actions.
A functioning conversational simulation that invokes computation, changes assumptions and retrieves persisted results; a prerecorded conversation is insufficient.
Completion of a runnable licensed repository, public demo video, tool feedback and Devpost submission before the deadline.
fakeable_parts: Original four-item routine and clearly labeled generated disturbance scenarios.
Bounded conversational vocabulary and templated explanations.
Local execution and file persistence instead of hosting or external integrations.
non_fakeable_core: Executable paired replay with identical starting states and disturbance identities, independently computed actions, trace-derived counts and reproducible persisted results after assumption changes.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: From the conversational simulation, compare both policies across the declared tiny scenario matrix. Inspect paired traces and independently verify counts, including unnecessary confirmations when nothing changed. Change a removal assumption, rerun and reload the saved result. Package runnable source, English instructions and feedback, publish a public video under three minutes, and complete Devpost.
notes: Most manageable scope here if limited to a synchronous local comparison rather than job infrastructure. Ten focused hours is plausible but unproven. Generated data removes access and privacy dependencies; no hardware, paid model or MCP server is required by the supplied simulation route. The main risk is implementing a model that predetermines its preferred outcome. Fixture results establish model behavior only. Ignore contradictory boilerplate claiming Fire TV, Bee and Ring are required.

critical_dependencies: A transactional persistent ledger enforcing version checks, append-only history and atomic correction acceptance.
A complete small dependency graph with independently checked invalidation and recomputation, including unaffected nodes.
An executable conversational confirmation workflow plus repository, public video, feedback and submission artifacts within the available time.
fakeable_parts: Fictional documents, pre-extracted assertions and explicitly fictional benefits rules.
Two clearly labeled simulated roles instead of production authentication.
A fixed small dependency graph and local receipt export.
non_fakeable_core: Applicant confirmation must cause an actual durable, attributed supersession transaction that preserves history, updates precisely the affected assessments and rejects stale writes without partial mutation.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Load conflicting fictional assertions. Have the helper propose a correction, retrieve its source and require applicant confirmation. Commit the replacement, display the affected dependency closure and export a receipt retaining unresolved conflicts. Reload to prove persistence, reject a stale correction and check cycle rejection. Deliver runnable licensed source, English documentation and feedback, public demonstration video and completed Devpost entry.
notes: Feasible only as a tightly bounded local simulation with prepared assertions; OCR, real benefits rules, real identity and distributed collaboration would threaten the ten-hour budget. The transactional graph semantics create more failure cases than the polished demo suggests. Simulated role selection proves workflow attribution, not authenticated identity. No real applicant data or benefits expertise is needed for the explicitly fictional scope. Existing gate passes provide no implementation evidence.

critical_dependencies: An accepted Fire TV device or emulator that can install, run and record the application; readiness is unverified.
Sound bounded temporal semantics and exhaustive subset checking that actually establish minimum conflict cardinality.
Remote navigation, field editing, durable review-task state and whole-routine revalidation integrated before recording and submission.
fakeable_parts: Original placeholder movement content and generated rule fixtures.
A tiny discrete timeline and a small fixed rule vocabulary.
Local review tasks instead of an external task-management service.
non_fakeable_core: On the accepted Fire TV platform, executable constraints must generate a minimum-cardinality conflict with source mappings, persist its review task and keep that task open until the entire edited routine is satisfiable.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: First install and operate a minimal app on the accepted platform. Load a bounded inconsistent routine, compute and verify its smallest conflict, and persist the review task. Edit a cited rule using the remote; show that another independent conflict prevents closure. Repair the remaining conflict, show a satisfying trace and playback, and classify a missing definition as indeterminate. Publish runnable source, setup instructions, feedback and a public demo video, then submit.
notes: Recommend dropping under the stated starting conditions: unverified platform setup, temporal-model correctness, conflict certificates and remote editing create several independent integration risks for one developer with ten build hours. Removing each conflict member proves irreducibility only; minimum cardinality also requires ruling out every smaller subset. Reconsider only if platform execution is immediately established and the model remains extremely small. Placeholder exercise content does not establish exercise safety, which is outside the stated proof.

critical_dependencies: A verified accepted Fire TV execution and recording route with working remote-focus controls.
A completely specified finite search space covering permitted omissions, ordering and timing, with a consistent preference-cost calculation.
Repair, conflict explanation, acceptance and playback integrated with enough remaining time for mandatory submission artifacts.
fakeable_parts: Six original illustrated cards and fictional contributor metadata.
Local attendance and permission fixtures instead of phone uploads or live family synchronization.
A short discrete timeline and fixed remote-accessible preference controls.
non_fakeable_core: The running Fire TV application must recompute a feasible minimum-cost repair from changed constraints, display an accurate edit ledger, enforce permissions during actual playback and report genuine infeasibility without silently relaxing hard constraints.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Establish accepted-platform execution first. Load six cards, change an attendance window using the remote, enumerate the declared bounded schedule space and independently validate feasibility and minimum cost. Accept the repair and play that sequence. Introduce incompatible pinned constraints and verify the reported conflict. Deliver licensed source and assets, reproducible setup, English feedback, a public demonstration video and the Devpost submission.
notes: More straightforward than the temporal conflict desk, but still a poor commitment while Fire TV readiness is unknown and development starts from scratch. Six cards alone does not bound search adequately if arbitrary start times and idle periods are allowed; define the discrete horizon and omission rules first. Local fixtures satisfy the proposed prototype scope, but do not demonstrate remote attendance or multi-phone ingestion. Reconsider if the platform boots immediately and those additional capabilities stay excluded.

critical_dependencies: A small, explicitly specified scheduling model in which intervention order actually changes outcomes; unlimited parallel work could make the comparison meaningless.
Correct coupling of exogenous disturbances across policies without incorrectly freezing policy-dependent durations or states.
A functioning conversational simulation, reproducible local repository, public demo video, and completed submission within the remaining execution budget.
fakeable_parts: Fictional trip records and seeded delay scenarios, clearly labeled synthetic.
Fleet integrations and operational deployment can be omitted.
Review-card styling and assistant phrasing can use templates.
non_fakeable_core: Independently execute both policies against shared disturbances, calculate paired outcomes from their traces, and recompute a genuine modeled preference reversal after a constraint change.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Specify one trip and two resource-constrained policies; verify identical-policy zero differences and seeded reproducibility; run the comparison conversationally, inspect a divergent trace, change the cutoff, and export recomputed results. Package runnable licensed source, English instructions and tool feedback; publish a functioning demo under three minutes and complete Devpost.
notes: Plausible only with a tightly bounded model. A manufactured reversal without defensible scheduling semantics would undermine the central proof. Synthetic data establish software behavior, not dispatch effectiveness. Ignore contradictory boilerplate asserting every conditional platform is material: the declared Alexa+ simulation route alone applies. Existing gate passes and perfect scores provide no implementation evidence.

critical_dependencies: Confirmed access to an accepted Fire TV device or emulator and a working deployment path; neither is established.
Creation of original clips and synchronized full/compact description assets with measured sizes and credible essential-event manifests.
Actual file replacement and offline playback with staging-space accounting, atomic allocation switching, and failure recovery.
fakeable_parts: Two tiny original clips and manually authored description packs can replace a real media library.
Storage reductions may be injected app limits if explicitly labeled.
Quality-loss weights and coverage requirements may be authored fixtures rather than validated viewer preferences.
non_fakeable_core: Run on the accepted Fire TV platform, compute a feasible minimum-cost allocation from actual asset sizes, commit real asset changes safely, and play the selected descriptions offline.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: First deploy a playback skeleton on the accepted platform. Add two clips with alternative packs, enumerate allocations, apply a reduced app budget through remote confirmation, and demonstrate actual changed playback. Show staging failure preserving the active allocation and an infeasible coverage case. Deliver licensed runnable source/assets, English documentation and feedback, public functioning-platform video, and Devpost submission.
notes: Recommend dropping this candidate under the stated ten-hour, solo, from-scratch assumption. Platform setup, remote accessibility, media authoring, synchronized playback, and transactional storage create several independent failure surfaces. Enumeration is the easy part. Bundling every alternative inside the installed app does not itself demonstrate reduced physical storage; distinguish active allocation bytes from total installed and staging bytes. Reconsider only after platform deployment and playback are already proven.

critical_dependencies: An independently specified fictional rule system and expected outcomes that are not generated by the engine being tested.
Clean-session replay with correction semantics, unresolved-input handling, and reproducible semantic outputs.
A bounded failure-reduction method and conversational runner that leave time for repository, video, feedback, and submission.
fakeable_parts: All assistance rules and transcripts may be original fictional fixtures.
Assistant explanations can be templated from actual assertion failures.
A tiny bounded transcript suite can replace broad program coverage.
non_fakeable_core: Execute baseline and changed rules from clean state, detect a seeded fault against independent assertions, export a rerunnable failure bundle, and produce a passing result after a real correction.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Author two small rule versions and a separate expectation manifest with correction, irrelevant-answer, and unresolved-input cases. Request validation conversationally, expose the seeded failure and first divergence, reduce the failing transcript with a stated criterion, export and reproduce it, then fix and rerun. Supply licensed runnable source, English setup and tool feedback, a public demo under three minutes, and completed Devpost fields.
notes: Deliverable if kept to a deterministic miniature engine. Generic rule ingestion, unrestricted natural-language normalization, and globally minimal transcript discovery would exceed the credible scope. Call the result regression validation rather than formal verification: passing a finite fictional suite proves neither exhaustive coverage nor benefits accuracy. Keep any language model outside deterministic replay or record its normalized inputs.

critical_dependencies: One authoritative guard-and-commit implementation shared by conversational and direct command paths, with session and state-version checks.
Conservative interpretation of confirmations and contradictions; ambiguous statements must preserve unknown state.
A functioning conversational simulation and completion of licensed source, English documentation, feedback, public video, and submission.
fakeable_parts: The departure routine, interruptions, and device actions may all be simulated.
Household evidence can consist entirely of session-local user assertions.
Speech and physical smart-lock integration can be omitted.
non_fakeable_core: Invalidate prior evidence after contradiction, reject missing or stale evidence through every command path, and commit exactly one simulated departure only against the current authorized state.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Implement the four-step state machine and conversational commands. Confirm keys, contradict possession, and show departure rejection with evidence history. Demonstrate direct-command and stale-version rejection, then freshly confirm possession and commit once; reject duplicate execution. Publish runnable licensed source with fixtures and English instructions/feedback, record a public functioning demo under three minutes, and complete Devpost.
notes: The smallest credible delivery surface of these candidates, although no implementation evidence supports the existing gate passes. Low risk assumes a narrow conversational vocabulary or reliable structured intent handling. Physical possession and real departure prevention remain outside the proof. The Alexa+ simulation alternative removes hardware, MCP, and gated API requirements; unrelated conditional-platform boilerplate should be removed.

critical_dependencies: Immediate access to a working Fire OS or Vega OS device or accepted emulator; access and deployment tooling are unconfirmed.
Correct persisted action lifecycle across timer delivery, cancellation, expiry, duplicate callbacks, and restart within approximately 10 solo build hours.
Time beyond implementation for reproducible licensed repository, platform recording, public video upload, product feedback, and completed submission.
fakeable_parts: Original minimal instruction assets for one demonstration routine.
Labeled scheduling fixtures and deliberately short demonstration rest intervals.
User completion and readiness supplied through real remote inputs rather than physical movement sensing.
non_fakeable_core: A working accepted-platform application must derive and persist a feasible pending action, revalidate it when due, require fresh readiness before playback, and prevent stopped, expired, or duplicate revisions from initiating playback.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Deploy to the accepted Fire TV runtime; demonstrate an infeasible window, approve a feasible replacement, persist the action, and observe a real due-time readiness prompt followed by confirmed playback. Exercise stop, expiry, duplicate delivery, and overdue restart with inspectable state. Package runnable source and English instructions, publish a short public functioning-demo video, supply tool feedback, and complete Devpost submission.
notes: Recommend dropping this option under the present unconfirmed platform access and solo time budget; reconsider only after a successful deployment smoke test. The foreground-only restriction reduces background scheduling work but leaves substantial state and playback verification. Generated gate passes establish no execution evidence. Assess as Fire TV only: copied claims assigning roles to every conditional technology contradict the explicit track selection and should be removed. No clinical validation is required for the stated event-based claim.

critical_dependencies: A complete small dependency graph with explicit time semantics, withdrawal handling, and selective results checked against full recomputation.
A functioning contextual Alexa+ simulation whose conversational inspection and confirmed hold/release actions operate on actual persisted application state.
Completion of runnable repository, public demonstration video, tool feedback, and submission alongside the approximately 10-hour solo implementation.
fakeable_parts: Clearly labeled synthetic records for two trucks and assignments.
Illustrative fleet policy with no claim of verified operational or legal coverage.
Local source mutations and local dispatch holds in place of external fleet integrations.
non_fakeable_core: Live evidence changes must invalidate and recompute the correct descendants while preserving independent branches, match full recomputation, and drive conversational explanations plus explicitly confirmed persistent hold/release actions.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Run the local simulated assistant against two synthetic truck branches; ask about readiness, withdraw one clearance, and inspect the changed evidence path and recomputation counts. Verify agreement with full recomputation and an unchanged independent branch. Confirm a hold, restore evidence, reload to prove persistence, and explicitly release the hold. Deliver licensed runnable source, English setup and feedback, a short public functioning-demo video, and completed Devpost entry.
notes: Most credible delivery option because the supplied simulation alternative removes hardware, gated SDK, MCP, and AWS dependencies. Keep conversation intents and graph scope narrow; adding fleet APIs or production policy coverage would undermine feasibility. Hash displays alone do not prove selective computation. Missing evidence should remain unknown while policy can separately block dispatch. Any external model dependency would add credentials, latency, and judge-access work absent from the current plan. Disregard copied conditional technology roles and unsupported gate passes.

critical_dependencies: A proven Fire OS or Vega OS deployment and remote-control route on an actual device or accepted emulator, currently unconfirmed.
Consistent three-valued temporal evaluation and trace minimization that preserves the same violation without corrupting session context.
Delivery of the TV interface, live event capture, corrective interaction, reproducible repository, and required submission artifacts within the solo time budget.
fakeable_parts: One original minimal instructional routine.
Clearly labeled synthetic regression traces.
Remote-reported repetitions and preparation instead of sensed movement.
non_fakeable_core: Real remote and timer events must feed the evaluator that controls progression, producing satisfied, violated, or indeterminate results and an executable subset-minimal explanation for the same identified violation.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: Deploy to an accepted Fire TV runtime and complete one short routine using remote input. Request the next set early to trigger a live block and computed counterexample; remove each necessary event and rerun to verify that specific violation disappears. Demonstrate a missing-confirmation indeterminate result and a corrective action. Publish runnable licensed source, English instructions and tool feedback, a short public platform-demo video, and the completed submission.
notes: Retain only with an immediate platform smoke-test gate; abandon if deployment consumes the implementation budget. This has fewer lifecycle obligations than Ready-Window but still combines unfamiliar platform work with nontrivial evaluator semantics. Event removal can turn a violation into missing context, so minimality must be defined against a fixed rule and session horizon. Keep the claim limited to reported sequence events; physical safety and exercise effectiveness are unproven. Copied conditional technology roles and deterministic gate passes are not compliance evidence.
